title: Restart fcitx5 cause Alacritty close.
author: llc0930
body:
> Please describe the bug that you have found:

Restart fcitx5 cause Alacritty close.

> and what you would expect to happen instead:

Alacritty should not be closed.
### System

OS: Debian GNU/Linux bookworm/sid x86_64
Version: alacritty 0.12.0-dev (e9ee8dc)
Display server: X11
Compositor: picom
WM: dwm

 cargo build with only X11 support
### Logs
[Alacritty-607924.log](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/files/9691451/Alacritty-607924.log)
